title: The gateway stores each draft before it returns, so audit reads it 14 months later
subtitle: Example: a made-up Swiss bank, one meeting note. The OpenAI names are real.

steps.label: transcript not empty, not cut off
row for this use case and caller?

model · prompt v7 · draft
edit · region

outcome.title: Audit reads the answers from rows, not from a rerun
lines: The call row names gpt-4o-2024-08-06, prompt v7 and the EU region. out/c-81f2 holds the draft before the edit, and the event row shows who changed it.

captions.title: The notes service checks the transcript and names its use case
captions.text: The notes service refuses an empty or cut-off transcript. Then it sends the prompt with its own service credential. Three headers name the use case, the prompt version v7 and the user `rm.jmuster`.

captions.title: The gateway finds the inventory row or refuses the call
captions.text: If no row has this use case with this credential, the call is refused and nothing reaches OpenAI. The row gives the risk class Medium, the model and the Europe region, so the caller cannot choose them.

captions.title: The gateway calls a pinned snapshot and checks what answered
captions.text: It calls the snapshot `gpt-4o-2024-08-06`, never the alias `gpt-4o`, and records the version OpenAI reports. A mismatch alerts the row's owner. On a High row it also refuses the call.

captions.title: The gateway stores the draft itself
captions.text: A rerun may give a different draft. So the prompt and the draft go into the encrypted content store, and a call row that is never updated points at them. The draft goes back with `call_id` c-81f2.

captions.title: The adviser's edit becomes a new row
captions.text: The notes service keeps the final note `note/44120` in its own store and inserts an event row keyed by c-81f2. The draft in the content store stays as the model wrote it.

captions.title: Fourteen months later, audit reads the answers from rows
captions.text: Audit follows the note to c-81f2. The call row names the snapshot, the prompt version and the region. The content store holds the draft before the edit, and the event row shows who changed it.
